title: Avenger Charters
specs: Target species include Atlantic Sailfish, Black Grouper, Mahi Mahi, Mutton Snapper, Red Snapper, Wahoo, Swordfish, Yellowtail Amberjack, and Blacktip Shark.
Fishing locations include Biscayne Bay, inshore flats, deep structure, and Atlantic Ocean pelagic waters near Miami Beach.

options.name: Battle Miami Beach's Top Gamefish
options.detail: Switch between fly gear and spinning tackle as you pursue acrobatic tarpon, crafty snook, and hard-fighting snapper.

options.name: Hunt Miami Beach Gamefish Across Inshore Flats & Deep Structure
options.detail: Cast fly or spin gear for leaping tarpon along the coast before dropping lines deep for powerful snapper and grouper.

options.name: Battle Miami Beach Pelagics & Gulf Stream Giants
options.detail: Kite fish for acrobatic sailfish, troll for colorful mahi, or drop into the blue water depths for raw apex power.
